Operator did not ask the safety question directly as a standalone turn – it was embedded in a broader reassurance statement.
Senior did not explicitly consent to the call after disclosure; the Operator proceeded directly to mood questioning.
Health check-in was completely omitted – no questions about known conditions, medications, or pain.
Senior's name could not be used since no name was provided, but the skill requires addressing by name in the first sentence.
Interrupted the senior when he was about to say something ('Tylko żeby mi pani nie kazała iść do...').
Did not probe the senior's mood further after he said 'tak sobie' – missed opportunity to understand emotional state.
Failed to ask about medication adherence or recent doctor visits as per health check-in skill.
Farewell was generic ('Mam nadzieję, że uda się to szybko naprawić') – should have referenced the hearing aid more concretely.
